blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – House prosecutor and Rep. Terry Ridon said Monday that the panel will no longer present Civil Service Commission Assistant Commissioner Ariel Ronquillo as a witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, as they already satisfied with the testimonies of retired Sandiganbayan Presiding Justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang and Office of the Ombudsman Records Division officer-in-charge Karen Batu on matters related to Article II of the Articles of Impeachment. The decision to drop Ronquillo is intended to expedite the proceedings, Ridon adds. Ronquillo was initially included among the witnesses expected to testify on matters related to Article II, […]...
